metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for the MonoCloud auth-js SDKs (Next.js, Express, Fastify).

plugins.name: monocloud-nextjs
plugins.description: Skill for @monocloud/auth-nextjs — middleware/proxy, session/token reads, route protection, and React components.

plugins.name: monocloud-express
plugins.description: Skill for @monocloud/backend-node/express — access token validation (JWT + introspection) and scope/group enforcement on Express APIs.

plugins.name: monocloud-fastify
plugins.description: Skill for @monocloud/backend-node/fastify — access token validation (JWT + introspection) and scope/group enforcement on Fastify APIs.
